verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only an official Thoropass MCP server, which lets external AI assistants act on a Thoropass workspace. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing shows Thoropass's own AI features (the AI Helpbot, First Pass AI, GenAI DDQ) can connect to external MCP servers or use their tools; the Helpbot answers from approved Thoropass documentation only.
